svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Figure 4: packets
svg.desc: Top: 200 small squares, each standing for about 10 packets, for 2,055 packets in all. Middle: resending one packet is 1,460 bytes, against 3,000,000 bytes for the whole photo. Bottom: one packet takes 1.2 ms on a 10 megabit link, while the photo sent as one piece would hold the link for 2.4 seconds; blue and purple packets from two people alternate on one wire.
svg.text: the photo as one piece = 2.4 s
your photo (blue) and your brother's match (purple) take turns
